received_works.body:
Hello! I hope you don't mind that I sent another request;; if its too troublesome please feel free to cancel!

I would like a picture of the same character as before, any pose is fine!
Thank you again for your consideration <3

https://toyhou.se/6666548.e-anona-rymre/gallery

Hey raisehaunk!

I did want to infact send another back to back which is unexpected as I also have another OC that I'd like you to illustrate in a similar style like how you did with this; https://skeb.jp/@raisehaunk/works/11 ! That being my Cyberpunk OC, Astra!

Her overall design is based on a rose. She is an introvert but friendly, fun and playful when you get to know her. As she’s a mercenary, she can also be cold and serious. She's more of a tomboy as well based on her clothing choices.

Character reference(s): https://ibb.co/album/1zpsbJ

Again, you're free to design the pose, expression and background! You can also draw her without wearing the jacket as well if you'd like! I'll leave it up to you!

Thank you so much! Please don't feel pressured to forcefully accept on this approval if you can't!

Hey raisehaunk!

I would like to request if you can illustrate my FFXIV OC as I really love the illustrations that you do like how you did with this one; https://skeb.jp/@raisehaunk/works/11

 Character references: https://ibb.co/album/NT7d8Z
(One thing to note, you'll notice that her flower hair accessory is floating. Please don't illustrate it floating!)

You're free to design the pose, expression and background!

Thank you!

Hello, I would like to request a portrait style drawing of my FFXIV character, Ruellia, as seen in one of your previous works: https://skeb.jp/@raisehaunk/works/11

Ruellia is a Viera with purple hair, red eyes, and dark blue facial tattoos. She has a reserved and quiet personality but cares deeply for her loved ones. I have provided references in the link.

I will leave the pose and expression up to you. Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kJSobi5OdPnrkelWZBXwc9OJovqYTUTB

It is a pleasure to meet you. I always look forward to seeing your illustrations.
I love the people you draw, especially their beautiful faces...!
If it is possible, I would like to use this character...?

Please contact me if possible....
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-lw42mjyAg4WyXtk-uznCSa259KBZQoF
She is a cyborg woman who always acts aloof and smiles, and is good at agitating people. (The right half of her body is prosthetic eye and limb. Under the one wearing the mask, the prosthetic eye is broken.) Deep down, she is cautious and has a stubborn side that does not trust others easily. He is in his early 20s.
He is in his early 20s.

There are two patterns: one with her hair flowing to the side and the other with her hair in a half up-do.
We would be happy if you could draw her face, so you can remove her hat and other decorations if you like!
Anyway, we would appreciate it if you could arrange it in a way that makes it easier to draw.

I know this is a very impolite request, so please cancel if the price is not reasonable. I would appreciate it if you could at least consider my request.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-lw42mjyAg4WyXtk-uznCSa259KBZQoF

Hello, I really love your art style! I hope you accept this request if you have time. I'd like you to draw Thoma and Yoimiya together from Genshin Impact. I want you to base it from the Sweets Paradise collaboration. I have uploaded everything in the folder for your references including the pose that I want. 

Here are some artworks from other artists with the same concept for you to have an idea what they look like. 
https://twitter.com/tamaya_yoi/status/1562128132647178241?s=20&t=fa66HMSvfVwg7U6tPPjeVg
https://twitter.com/nanguatou4/status/1564552497603022848?t=8jQyys80tbw2EmBIskOhpw&s=19
https://twitter.com/bobateadango/status/1565470746440536064?s=20&t=adrWd1iuF-fvUlj7SNkoLQ

I also want you to put a simple background that will suit the theme. Maybe you can use black or any color and put gold butterflies or stars. It's up to you to choose that will look good on the art. Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WyF8CNpyx3XXGS4I1tx6ftAwuyVbmgAv?usp=sharing

Hello Dr. Ma, my name is Urui. Thank you very much for your very nice illustration the other day. I look at it every day and feel happy...!
I would like to make another request using the original character you drew last time. The appearance of the character should be the same.

Pose: I would like a smiling expression with her elbows on the armrests of a desk or chair, with cheekbones, but with a somewhat sexy impression.
Clothing: Over a white or black tank top, a slightly sporty hoodie is worn open in the front with the shoulders down (one shoulder down or both shoulders down, we leave it to you). The hoodie is mainly in cold colors and the design is left up to you. The skin on the shoulders is visible and looks a little sexy.
Nails are painted black.
She wears earrings, necklace, and rings as silver accessories. We will leave it to the teacher's taste.

She is a beautiful, neutral female (often mistaken for a handsome man. She looks about 21 years old. She should not have breasts for the illustration. Shoulders should not be too broad.)
She has a cat-like image and fair skin.
Her hair color is black to dark purple, and it is long enough to cover one eye.
Eye color: clear purple. She has long eyelashes (with lower lashes).
Her personality is fresh and aloof, with an occasional bewitching expression.

We are planning to distribute her in the future and would be happy to use her as an icon or background for distribution.

Thank you in advance for your time.

Nice to meet you!
My name is Kanou, and I am the management support person for an individual artist named "Raise".

I am an 18-year-old female singer who is trying her best in her music career.
She has not released any proper works on the Internet yet, so she is no different from ordinary people.
However, she has a very wonderful voice and charm, and she has been approached by many people in the music industry, and we would like to start a full-fledged activity.
We would like to ask "Numa," who has been a big fan of Kurose herself, if she would be willing to write an illustration to be used as an icon for our project.

If you accept, please use the following URL as a starting point
If you accept, would it be possible to use the following URL photo as a basis for your request?

Thank you very much for your consideration.

＝＝＝＝＝＝
Kanou
j_kanou@ve.jvcmusic.co.jp
＝＝＝＝＝＝

https://www.dropbox.com/s/aw0c0y0xg8yt6nt/S__30588934.jpg?dl=0

Hello!

Can you draw my friend's vtuber Ran (https://twitter.com/rancchu/status/1556049086209728512/photo/1) in this outfit and pose (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lCqu4peokMba-qKUravYVXqkq-iSQxFz?usp=sharing), and my vtuber Chai (https://twitter.com/reixuu/status/1507902721608740866/photo/1) in this outfit and pose (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18QZXWz9MtKzFBGX2ZfUxUI56ftY4yjlW?usp=sharing)

Thank you!!

Hello! I love the way you draw! I would like a drawing of my Final Fantasy 14 character. He is gentle and laid-back. Please pay attention to the darker color at the ends of his ears and do not draw the sunglasses in the reference URL. The pose and expression are up to you!

https://ibb.co/album/jPY6cr

Hello, my name is Kokoru Mochi.
I always enjoy looking at your wonderful illustrations...!

I would like to send you a request to draw an original character from the following URL.

Please leave the pose to me. The character's personality is calm, gentle, gentle, calm.... We hope this will be helpful 🙇♀️.
The character's face is beautiful with a little bit of cuteness mixed in.

I hope you will consider my proposal.
I will continue to support you behind your back!

https://twitter.com/coco_04060/status/1526832836703318016?s=21&t=hFjyqXumnry28xwNFnizSw

Hi Dr. Ma, nice to meet you.
My name is Shahram and I am a traveling merchant and a private Vtuber.
Please take a look at my Twitter page to see what I look like.
(https://twitter.com/shahramVT)

I found your wonderful illustration and would like to send a request to you.
I also like Hara-Kami very much and often distribute his works, and I would like to request one of his illustrations to be used in my distribution.

Illustration outline
There are no particular composition requirements.
(Jonglei or Tartarya would be a good fit, but you can choose a character that you think would be a good fit.)
If the above is not possible, an illustration of Shahram in the image of the original deity.
If neither of the above is possible, we would like to have an illustration of Shahram in the image of the original god.
If neither of the above is possible, please use Shahram drawn by Ma, regardless of the original deity.

Intended use
I will use it within the scope of my activities as a Vtuber (distribution, announcements, etc.).

I am sorry for your busy schedule, but we would appreciate your consideration.
You can see the three views from my Twitter page, but you can see the high quality standing picture from my mom's page, so I will list the URL for the year.

https://twitter.com/Hk_Nemo/status/1396475106268835845

Hello! Your artwork is beautiful. May I request my FFXIV character, please? She has a playful personality. Please draw her with a smile. I will leave the rest to you. Thank you for your consideration.

https://imgur.com/a/kS06oAZ

Would you consider my original character?
https://i.imgur.com/iMw7CQm.png
 Please do not draw his mask. I would like him drawn in a different outfit chosen by you.
Maybe something casual or something loose ( like an oversized sweater ) 
Pose and expression are also up to you.

Thank you for your consideration.

Hello, I love your drawings. If possible, please let her draw freely. Thank you very much. Here is the URL.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/a5QFFqxsgWUZGzEh8

Hi! I really like your artworks. May I request an illustration of my ffxiv character, a Viera boy? Feel free to draw as you like! Reference is included in the link below. Thank you for your consideration

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yzpzrWOG3lEMoL5EAlmhmrVzfkqK8d7s?usp=sharing

He was one of the angels entrusted by God to manage the world, but he rebelled against a world completely ruled by God and tried to kill God. At the end of his life, he divides the world into three worlds. The human world, the heavenly world, and the demon world. He became the first demon king, but he was also cursed by God. He was cursed with "fear of the light of day" and "limited life span," and this curse was passed down to his people. His personality is a bit snappy, his eyes look ferocious but he is actually easy to talk to.
 Pose with sucking gloves please!

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gvxbwjHuB26G8tu8nojhDhw3Q9SY2G-t?usp=sharing

I would like to request a drawing of my original character, Mamoru: https://sta.sh/2o440h42ail

Thank you for your consideration.
